_comment: System-wide search terms the discovery cron uses against title-based aggregators (JSearch/Adzuna/Jooble/TheirStack). Discovery is no longer per-candidate (2026-09-06) — this is the interim stand-in for the admin mode described in the F4 plan doc, which will let an admin edit this list from a UI instead of a committed file. Keep it curated, not exhaustive — every title here gets queried on every cron tick.
